The Enterprise team builds LaunchDarkly for the customers who push it hardest. Global banks, national health systems, and Fortune 100 manufacturers run us across thousands of engineers and tens of thousands of flags, inside audit and change control processes most software never meets.

That scale breaks things that work fine everywhere else. A permissions model designed for a hundred users can be the reason a rollout to twenty thousand stalls. Volume creates a different class of problem, where a flag payload that costs nothing to deliver once gets expensive across a large service fleet. Your work is to find where a current design stops holding and build what replaces it. You will own that end to end, in Go on the backend and TypeScript and React on the frontend.

The problems fall into a few areas:

• Governance and access control. Roles, permissions, approvals, and audit trails that satisfy a regulator.

• Scale and performance. Finding the limit before the customer does, then changing the design rather than tuning around it.

• Programmatic control. Our public API, Terraform provider, and configuration surfaces, so a platform team can run LaunchDarkly as infrastructure.

• Resilience under real constraints. Data residency, regional isolation, and sane behavior when a dependency is degraded.

Enterprise runs closer to its own business than most product teams. Roughly half the roadmap traces back to requests from named customers, so you will often know who is waiting on your work and what it unblocks for them. You will speak with those customers directly. The other half is larger forward-looking work, where the brief is a capability our biggest customers will need rather than one they have already asked for.

Responsibilities:

• Own features end to end: problem framing with your PM and designer, technical design, implementation across backend and frontend, rollout, and the operational life of the thing after it ships.

• Design for enterprise constraints from the start. Permissions and access control, approval and audit requirements, data residency and regional isolation, and the behavior of the system when a region or dependency is degraded.

• Find and fix scalability and performance limits before customers do. Identify where a current design stops holding at the top end of our customer base, quantify it, and lead the work to change it.

• Make LaunchDarkly manageable at fleet scale. Extend our public API, Terraform provider, and configuration surfaces so a platform team can operate LaunchDarkly as infrastructure rather than click through it.

• Work directly with customers. Join escalations and discovery calls, read the support and account signal, and turn a specific customer's problem into something that serves the whole segment rather than a one-off.

• Raise operability of what the team owns. Observability, runbooks, and participation in the on-call rotation, plus the follow-through after an incident.

• Drive alignment beyond your own team. Enterprise depends on and is depended on by several other teams, so surfacing a misalignment early and getting the right people in a room is a real part of the job at this level.

• Mentor and review. Give substantive review on specifications and pull requests, including for engineers on neighboring teams, and help newer engineers get faster.

Qualifications:

• 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of features you drove from design through production.

• Genuine full stack ability. Strong in a statically typed backend language and comfortable owning frontend work rather than handing it off. Our stack is Go on the backend and TypeScript and React on the frontend.

• Experience building for enterprise customers. Multi-tenancy, roles and permissions, SSO and identity, audit logging, approval workflows, or compliance requirements in a production product.

Fundada em 2016 e reconhecida como uma das melhores empresas para trabalhar pelo GPTW (Great Place to Work 2023), a Vee se uniu à Swile, a mais inovadora ScaleUp europeia e que revolucionou o mercado de benefícios na França em 2021, se tornando um unicórnio global 🚀

title: Stagiaire Marketing & Réseaux Sociaux France
description:
À propos de BlaBlaCar
BlaBlaCar est la première communauté mondiale de covoiturage et de voyage en bus, rassemblant plus de 26 millions de membres chaque année dans 40 pays. Nos 1000 collaborateurs, issus de plus de 50 nationalités, sont répartis dans 5 bureaux internationaux, avec 30 % de l’équipe en télétravail complet.
Rejoindre BlaBlaCar, c’est participer à une aventure humaine et technologique unique, au service d’une mission : rendre la mobilité partagée plus accessible, conviviale et durable.

Ta mission

Au sein de l’équipe Business & Marketing France, tu intégreras une équipe dédiée à la croissance de la communauté BlaBlaCar et tu travailleras sur des problématiques diverses et les différentes business unit de BlaBlaCar (covoiturage, bus, train).
Tu intégreras l’équipe Marketing France et tu auras un rôle clé dans l’animation de nos réseaux sociaux pour engager la communauté BlaBlaCar. En lien avec l’agence spécialisée et en collaboration avec le Marketing Manager, tu contribueras à développer la notoriété et l’attractivité de la marque, avec un focus particulier sur TikTok et les nouvelles tendances sur les réseaux sociaux. Tu participeras aussi au déploiement de stratégies pour développer l’attractivité de BlaBlaCar auprès de la communauté étudiant.e.s..
Tes responsabilités

Participer au développement de la stratégie de contenus pour nos réseaux sociaux (TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.) en lien avec le Marketing Manager.
Proposer, créer, publier du contenu engageant (vidéos, stories, formats innovants) et agir en tant que community manager
Identifier et exploiter les tendances TikTok et les adapter aux codes de BlaBlaCar.
Suivre et analyser les performances des campagnes (reach, engagement, conversions).
Collaborer avec les équipes Brand, Design et C
